title: Trust & Safety of LLMs and LLMs in Trust & Safety
measurement_description: The paper reviews literature that evaluates bias and discrimination in LLMs based on protected attributes, explicitly including religion. It cites studies providing empirical evidence of biased associations and stereotypes related to religion.
findings: Through a literature review, the paper identifies that LLMs can perpetuate and amplify stereotypes and biased associations related to religion, flagging this as a significant trust and safety concern. Bias and discrimination based on religion is listed as a key performance indicator for LLM safety.
